title: Headlong Hall
author: Thomas Love Peacock
description: "Headlong Hall" by Thomas Love Peacock is a novella written in 1815 and published in 1816.
longDescription: At a Welsh country estate, Squire Headlong hosts a Christmas gathering of eccentric philosophers and intellectuals, each obsessed with a single idea.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Love Peacock (1785–1866) wrote Headlong Hall. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
